'''Kaede Hondo''' (Japanese: '''本渡楓''' ''Kaede Hondo'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Kaede was born on March 6, 1996, in Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. Kaede became a voice actor in 2015 and joined [[Pokémon animation]] during [[POKÉTOON]], voicing [[Peaches]], and is featured in {{aniseries|HZ}} as [[Iono]].
